decision: REJECT_RAW_BUFFER_REUSE: exact lifetime and regression checks pass, but entropy is slower in all three paired trials. Production remains342483aa; the no-regression performance gate is not met.
scope: Numeric1920x1080 pushFrame only on Apple M2 Max, Node24.19.0;90 timestamped frames,15 excluded warmup,diagnostics enabled,3 alternating trials per variant/workload in fresh processes. Six workloads; no input sampling, quantization, threshold change or omitted diagnostic fields.
nativeBoundary: The low-contrast-rgb workload reproduces the native shader uint32 hash and RGB formula with bottom-left to top-left row conversion. It is not actual capture, I420 colour conversion, IPC, rendering or browser-cadence evidence.

reconstruction.contains: Both exact source trees, patch, manifests, original harnesses and all original output files as lossless UTF8 strings. originalFileHashes verifies each original byte sequence after extraction.

originalMetadataNote: manifest.json and HANDOFF.md preserve their preparation-time statement that tests had not run. The subsequently recorded lifetime, engine and36-trial files establish execution; no original metadata was silently rewritten.

ownershipContract.reuse: Only a fully evicted raw buffer of identical length is reused within the same push. Delta promotion retains ownership of its raw base; there is no persistent free-buffer pool.
ownershipContract.historyOnlyBoundary: The1536x1536 epoch-reset case exercises DiagnosticHistory in isolation beyond the product pixel cap; it is not product support for that capture size.

lifetimeProof.scope: Exact raw-buffer ownership, retained payloads, evidence, input non-aliasing,96-frame and16MiB byte-pressure eviction. Numeric buffers only. Epoch test is history-only and beyond the product pixel cap.

engineProof.scope: Deterministic complete finish() and live callback comparison to frozen source; array types, unaligned fallback, alpha/black resets, history forks, source changes, timestamp gaps and interruption. This is regression evidence, not independent normative validation.

summary.recommendation: Do not integrate unconditionally: lifetime and report equality pass, but entropy is slower in all three paired trials and its median p95 regresses. Smaller gains on texture/gradient and low-contrast do not satisfy the no-regression gate. Preserve the experiment; no production changes.

originalTrialReport.scope: Numeric pushFrame CPU only, 90 synthetic timestamped buffers, 15 warmup frames, diagnostics on; excludes fixture generation, capture, conversion, IPC. New process each workload/trial. Unmodified complete finish() hashes compared. Additional immutable lookup bytes reported separately; stateBytes unchanged because no persistent buffer pool is introduced.
